title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

suppliers.sup:70510: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Part 350011 – 2027 terms: price and payment days
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer. We understand the copper pressure and do not dispute your cost drivers. However, our current contract ctr:4600070510 runs with 90 days payment terms, and moving to 30 days would add a further cost on top of the 6.5 % increase. We propose keeping 90 days at your new price of EUR 370.96, or alternatively 60 days at EUR 366.50. As the change exceeds 2 %, could your pricing committee review these options at its next meeting? Please also tell us whether any lower-cost variant of the 7.5 kW motor would meet our specification.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Part 350011 – 2027 terms: price and payment days
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €374.72 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

We have noted your request for extended payment terms and forwarded your inquiry regarding a lower-cost variant to our technical department for review. To accommodate your preference for 60 days payment terms, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 372.65 as an alternative: a price of €372.65 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This adjustment strictly reflects the additional financing costs associated with the extended payment period.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Application Engineering: Please note that we build strictly according to your provided drawing, and we do not propose any design changes.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
